requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: The Out-of-Box Experience (OOBE) for 123.hp.com must present only one consistent product name/reference for the HP OfficeJet Pro 9010 series, to minimize user confusion and errors.

requirements.Requirement: Printer able to run all new/current EM / market segment media
requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: The printer must reliably print on all new and current Electromagnetic (EM) and market segment-specific media types, meeting intervention specifications for different media and climatic conditions on the Manhattan platform.

requirements.Requirement: Product can be placed and work on uneven surface ( sofa , table cloth , carpet …)
requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: The printer must operate without hardware failure when placed on uneven surfaces such as sofas, table cloths, or carpets, specifically ensuring the input tray sensor flag does not break.

requirements.Requirement: Tilt left and right each while printing
requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: The printer must be assessed for functional failure when tilted 20 degrees left and right during printing, to determine if it meets customer requirements.

requirements.Requirement: Put printer on trolley and print
requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: The printer must maintain print quality and operate reliably when placed on a moving trolley during printing.
